## Standing operator rules: every standing rule or constraint the operator has set, copied verbatim with its exact condition and required step, even if it has not come up recently.
- Do not raise SQLAlchemy pool size to 50; it caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging. Do not try it again.
- Run `make license-check` from the repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`.
- Never edit `tests/conftest.py` without posting the proposed diff in `#ledgerly-tests` and waiting for `@mira` to approve it.
- Run `prod-db-credential-rotation` steps in order, one at a time: check Vault availability; record the current lease; mint and validate the replacement; update the Kubernetes secret; restart `deployment/orders-api`; verify startup; revoke the old lease; remove temporary files.
- Operator: please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Operator: can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?
- Operator: Correction on buckets: staging exports now go to ledgerly-exports-stg-v2. The old ledgerly-exports-stg bucket is frozen for an audit and must not be written to.
- Operator: Put the SQLAlchemy upgrade on hold. Switch to adding a CSV import for vendor credits in ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py; finance needs it this week.

## Recent work: a short narrative of what was done recently and what is still relevant.
CSV exporter now explicitly writes UTF-8; regression coverage passes, full suite: `186 passed, 3 skipped`, and Ruff/diff checks pass. Invoice baseline: `12 passed`; annotations were started in `ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`, with `compileall` successful. Production restart completed; credential verification, lease revocation, and cleanup remain.
